title: Keep attachments, tags and notes when merging a pending duplicate

files.patch:
@@ -455,6 +455,15 @@ def merge_with_duplicate!
       # cannot race on reading/writing extra (e.g., the manual_merge array).
       posted_tx = posted_entry.entryable
       posted_tx.lock! if posted_tx.is_a?(Transaction)
+
+      # Moving the attachments bypasses validation, so refuse a merge that would
+      # leave the posted transaction over the limit instead of dropping files.
+      if posted_tx.is_a?(Transaction) && pending_entry.entryable.is_a?(Transaction) &&
+          attachment_count_after_merge(from: pending_entry.entryable, to: posted_tx) > MAX_ATTACHMENTS_PER_TRANSACTION
+        Rails.logger.info("merge_with_duplicate! rejected: merging pending entry #{pending_entry_id} would exceed #{MAX_ATTACHMENTS_PER_TRANSACTION} attachments")
+        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
+      end
+
       if posted_tx.is_a?(Transaction)
         tx_attrs = {}
 
@@ -487,15 +496,27 @@ def merge_with_duplicate!
         end
 
         posted_tx.update!(tx_attrs) if tx_attrs.any?
+
+        # Keep what the user added to the pending transaction (e.g. a receipt attached
+        # before the bank booked it); destroying the pending entry would purge it.
+        pending_transaction = pending_entry.entryable
+        carry_over_user_additions(from: pending_transaction, to: posted_tx) if pending_transaction.is_a?(Transaction)
       end
 
       # Date inheritance on the Entry row — separate from the Transaction update above.
+      entry_attrs = {}
       unless posted_entry.protected_from_sync?
         # Date: pending dates reflect actual transaction initiation time
-        posted_entry.update!(date: pending_entry_date) if posted_entry.date != pending_entry_date
+        entry_attrs[:date] = pending_entry_date if posted_entry.date != pending_entry_date
         # Name + Merchant intentionally NOT inherited — booked values are canonical
       end
 
+      # Notes are the user's own text, so they are kept even on a protected entry.
+      notes = merged_notes(posted_entry.notes, pending_entry.notes)
+      entry_attrs[:notes] = notes if notes != posted_entry.notes
+
+      posted_entry.update!(entry_attrs) if entry_attrs.any?
+
       # Lock the posted entry so future syncs cannot overwrite the merged state
       posted_entry.mark_user_modified!
 
@@ -550,6 +571,37 @@ def pending_duplicate_candidates(limit: 20, offset: 0)
   end
 
   private
+    # Moves the pending transaction's attachments (the attachment rows themselves, so the
+    # blobs are not purged with the pending entry) and adds its tags to the posted one.
+    def carry_over_user_additions(from:, to:)
+      if from.attachments.attached?
+        # A blob already attached to the posted transaction would collide with the
+        # unique index on attachments once re-pointed, and is kept there anyway.
+        from.attachments_attachments.where(blob_id: to.attachments_attachments.select(:blob_id)).delete_all
+        from.attachments_attachments.update_all(record_id: to.id)
+      end
+
+      new_tags = from.tags.where.not(id: to.tags.select(:id))
+      to.tags << new_tags if new_tags.any?
+    end
+
+    def attachment_count_after_merge(from:, to:)
+      to_blob_ids = to.attachments_attachments.pluck(:blob_id)
+      to_blob_ids.size + from.attachments_attachments.where.not(blob_id: to_blob_ids).count
+    end
+
+    # Notes merged earlier are joined by blank lines, so look for the pending
+    # note's paragraphs, in order, among the posted note's: "Order 123" is not
+    # already in "Order 1234", and a multi-paragraph note is not split apart.
+    def merged_notes(posted_notes, pending_notes)
+      return posted_notes if pending_notes.blank?
+      return pending_notes if posted_notes.blank?
+      posted_parts = posted_notes.split(/\n{2,}/).map(&:strip)
+      pending_parts = pending_notes.split(/\n{2,}/).map(&:strip)
+      return posted_notes if posted_parts.each_cons(pending_parts.size).include?(pending_parts)
+
+      "#{posted_notes}\n\n#{pending_notes}"
+    end

@@ -305,4 +306,127 @@ class Transaction::MergeWithDuplicateTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
     @pending_entry.transaction.update!(extra: {})
     assert_equal [], @pending_entry.transaction.pending_duplicate_candidates.to_a
   end
+
+  test "moves the pending transaction's attachments to the posted transaction" do
+    pending_tx = @pending_entry.transaction
+    pending_tx.attachments.attach(io: StringIO.new("receipt"), filename: "receipt.pdf", content_type: "application/pdf")
+    blob = pending_tx.attachments.first.blob
+
+    perform_enqueued_jobs do
+      assert pending_tx.merge_with_duplicate!
+    end
+
+    posted_tx = @posted_entry.transaction.reload
+    assert_equal [ blob.id ], posted_tx.attachments.map(&:blob_id)
+    assert ActiveStorage::Blob.exists?(blob.id), "the receipt must not be purged with the pending entry"
+    assert_equal "receipt", posted_tx.attachments.first.download
+  end
+
+  test "adds the pending transaction's tags to the posted transaction" do
+    shared = @family.tags.create!(name: "Shared")
+    reimbursable = @family.tags.create!(name: "Reimbursable")
+    @pending_entry.transaction.tags << [ shared, reimbursable ]
+    @posted_entry.transaction.tags << shared
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal %w[Reimbursable Shared], @posted_entry.transaction.reload.tags.map(&:name).sort
+  end
+
+  test "keeps the pending entry's notes on the posted entry" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Lunch with client", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "appends the pending entry's notes to existing notes on the posted entry" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client")
+    @posted_entry.update!(notes: "Booked")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Booked\n\nLunch with client", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "appends a pending note that is only a substring of the posted note" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Order 123")
+    @posted_entry.update!(notes: "Order 1234")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Order 1234\n\nOrder 123", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "does not repeat a pending note already merged into the posted note" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client")
+    @posted_entry.update!(notes: "Booked\n\nLunch with client")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Booked\n\nLunch with client", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "does not repeat a multi-paragraph pending note identical to the posted note" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client\n\nPaid by card")
+    @posted_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client\n\nPaid by card")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Lunch with client\n\nPaid by card", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "does not repeat a multi-paragraph pending note already merged into the posted note" do
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client\n\nPaid by card")
+    @posted_entry.update!(notes: "Booked\n\nLunch with client\n\nPaid by card")
+
+    @pending_entry.transaction.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal "Booked\n\nLunch with client\n\nPaid by card", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
+
+  test "keeps one attachment when both transactions have the same blob" do
+    pending_tx = @pending_entry.transaction
+    posted_tx = @posted_entry.transaction
+    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: StringIO.new("receipt"), filename: "receipt.pdf", content_type: "application/pdf")
+    pending_tx.attachments.attach(blob)
+    posted_tx.attachments.attach(blob)
+
+    assert pending_tx.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert_equal [ blob.id ], posted_tx.reload.attachments.map(&:blob_id)
+  end
+
+  test "refuses a merge that would leave more than the attachment limit" do
+    pending_tx = @pending_entry.transaction
+    posted_tx = @posted_entry.transaction
+    6.times { |i| posted_tx.attachments.attach(io: StringIO.new("posted #{i}"), filename: "posted#{i}.pdf", content_type: "application/pdf") }
+    5.times { |i| pending_tx.attachments.attach(io: StringIO.new("pending #{i}"), filename: "pending#{i}.pdf", content_type: "application/pdf") }
+
+    assert_not pending_tx.merge_with_duplicate!
+
+    assert Entry.exists?(@pending_entry.id), "the pending entry and its attachments must be kept"
+    assert_equal 5, pending_tx.reload.attachments.count
+    assert_equal 6, posted_tx.reload.attachments.count
+  end
+
+  test "keeps attachments, tags and notes when the posted entry is protected from sync" do
+    pending_tx = @pending_entry.transaction
+    pending_tx.attachments.attach(io: StringIO.new("receipt"), filename: "receipt.pdf", content_type: "application/pdf")
+    blob = pending_tx.attachments.first.blob
+    reimbursable = @family.tags.create!(name: "Reimbursable")
+    pending_tx.tags << reimbursable
+    @pending_entry.update!(notes: "Lunch with client")
+    @posted_entry.mark_user_modified!
+
+    perform_enqueued_jobs do
+      assert pending_tx.merge_with_duplicate!
+    end
+
+    posted_tx = @posted_entry.transaction.reload
+    assert_equal [ blob.id ], posted_tx.attachments.map(&:blob_id)
+    assert_includes posted_tx.tags, reimbursable
+    assert_equal "Lunch with client", @posted_entry.reload.notes
+  end
 end
